morgan: Pushed raven-v2 q4_roundtrip to canary and ran the funcall compliance suite. Seeing ~0.8% schema failures on tool calls — most are truncated/malformed JSON (missing closing brace or trailing garbage). Anyone else hitting this on quantized roundtrip?

arjun: Yep, I reproduced. Looks intermittent and correlated with ~350 token outputs where tokenization boundary crosses a function call. Example: 
```
expected: {
  \"action\": \"search\",
  \"args\": {\"q\": \"...\"}
} 
actual: {\"action\":\"search\",\"args\":{\"q\":\"foo\"}

}
```
(really subtle extra newline + truncated fragment).

morgan: My hypothesis: quant->dequant introduces tiny probability mass shifts at the tokenizer-level so beam/greedy cutoffs fall on different token boundaries, ending response mid-json. We saw something similar in earlier int8 probes but this feels new for raven-v2 q4.

leah: Quick check: are we using aggressive prefix KV caching on canary? If cache returns an older prefix length, it can change alignment.

morgan: Cache is on with default policies in canary. I toggled cache off and failures dropped to 0.2% in the short run.

samir: If disabling cache helps, we should add a test for prefix-alignment with quantized models. Also we should try the parse-rescue retry: attempt strict JSON parse, on fail run `jsonrepair` heuristic that strips trailing non-json until brace-match, then re-parse. In eval harness we can limit to 1 retry to avoid silent corruption.

arjun: Agreed. I'll prototype a light-weight rescue in the eval harness: `parse_with_rescue(resp) -> (parsed, repaired_raw)` and track metrics: rescue_count, repaired_success. We should avoid changing model-generated content unless necessary.

eval-bot: CI run #raven-195: funcall-suite on raven-v2-q4_roundtrip finished: 1200 tests, failures=9, rescue_success=6, unrecoverable=3. Logs: ci.redwood.ai/runs/195000/funcall-suite (private).

leah: For the unrecoverable 3, can someone paste the raw outputs? I want to check token boundary patterns.

morgan: Pasted one inline: 
```
RAW: \"{\\\"action\\\":\\\"create_ticket\\\",\\\"args\\\":{\\\"title\\\":\\\"Deploy error\\\",\\\"body\\\":\\\"Missing header at line 42\\\"}\\\"}garbage

```
See the `}garbage` suffix. Rescue heuristic can trim after the last top-level close brace.

samir: Another angle: reduce stop token set or enforce function-call token boundary by appending a safe sentinel like `\n\n###END_JSON###` in prompt and strip it server-side. But that changes prompt shapes and might affect generation quality. Maybe use it only for canary quant runs.

arjun: Let's do both: (1) implement one-retry json rescue in eval harness and expose metrics, (2) run an experiment toggling prefix cache and sentinel suffix to measure impact on semantic correctness and failure rate.

morgan: I'll open a tracking issue with repro, attach the canary config (q4_roundtrip, kv_cache=on, batch_size=8, temp=0.0) and assign to eng-ml. Also adding a regression test to the funcall-suite that runs 5k calls and asserts recovery rate >= 99.8% with optional rescue.

ci-bot: Created issue RED-ml/4712: "raven-v2-q4 funcall truncation around token boundaries" and linked canary run. Assignee: arjun.

leah: Thanks — if arjun needs GPU time for large runs ping infra. Short-term mitigation: disable prefix caching for raven-v2-q4 in canary.

morgan: I'll flip cache off for canary and re-run nightly. Will report back tomorrow with delta. :thumbsup:
